references.text: The context of giving with a willing heart to the poor prepares the command in verse 10 to give without reluctance.
He who has a good eye shall be blessed, for he gives of his bread to the poor - the same principle of blessing for generosity.
The generous soul shall be satisfied, and he who waters shall himself be watered - blessing follows the one who gives.
He who shows mercy to the poor lends to the Lord, and He will repay him for his good deed.
Paul cites the principle of giving with joy, not with sorrow or compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
He who sows sparingly shall reap sparingly, and he who sows bountifully shall reap bountifully - blessing for generosity.
The command to help brothers when they become poor, showing care for the needy in Israel.
He who has worldly goods and sees his brother in need but closes his heart against him - an appeal to practical generosity.
